Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

talk on the phone verb

also phone call, call, telephone, local call, long-distance call, telephone call

modern

Traupman 38

cum aliquō tēlephōnicē colloquī

talk to someone on the phone

Other words

  • colloquium tēlephōnicum — a phone call

    also used · modern · Traupman 38: telephone call (local, long-distance), colloquium tēlephōnicum (locāle, longinquum)

    Longinquum, long-distance, is classical; locālis is late Latin (Lewis & Short).

See also the phone is ringing.
